question: How do you usually get things together for the walking group?
model_evidence: model and effort in native CLI rollout turn_context record
raw: “I wash the bibs, then lay things out in the evening when the kitchen’s quiet. Sometimes my housemate reads the jobs back to me while I gather everything—that helps if there are several bits to do. And now the bus card’s in the pocket of the bib bag, so I won’t be hunting for that separately. Clean bibs are all very well, but they do need to come along with me!”
